title: Veritas repeats fabricated Sussex Police claims during safeguarding call
summary: Emma Jones references supposed welfare checks on 18 & 22 June 2025, but victim confirms no such contact ever occurred. Veritas also fails to recognise NICE link submissions and incorrect crime reference is mentioned.

title: PC Dixon still finalising case months after suicide disclosure
summary: Despite prior removal from the case, Sussex Police informed Veritas that PC Dixon was still handling the investigation — contradicting previous records. Victim states this retraumatises them.
quote: I never want to see PC Dixon again — that would retraumatise me.

title: Veritas claims NICE Links not used — contradicts submission records
summary: Despite having sent several NICE links with suicide-related evidence and call recordings, Sussex Police told Veritas they weren’t used. Veritas repeated this falsehood back to the victim.
quote: No, no, no — I sent that via a NICE link…
